ui_bugs.issue: 'Capabilitățile mele' link (data-testid=link-capabilities) is gated behind welcome hero which requires user.verified && tierInfo.canSeeBentoHero (tier >= ADVANCED). specialist@propmanage.io currently has tier=VERIFIED, so the hero renders and the link IS present (count=1 when scrolled), BUT the first playwright run showed count=0 initially before hero rendered. During second attempt hero was present. Non-blocking, but users with tier < ADVANCED (ENTRY/JUNIOR) will not see the link at all — no alternative entry point to /specialist/capabilities exists on dashboard for lower tiers.

action_items: Consider adding link-capabilities entry point outside of tier-gated welcome hero (e.g. in the profile/settings tab) so ENTRY/JUNIOR specialists can also access the editor from the dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: capability_engine.py is a single ~350 LOC file — clean, no _id leakage (uses str(_id) in find results), async/await proper, Pydantic-less body validated inline with clear HTTPException messages. Good.

SpecialistDashboard.jsx: link-capabilities entry point only rendered inside `canSeeBentoHero` hero card (tier>=ADVANCED gate). Lower-tier specialists cannot navigate to /specialist/capabilities from the UI. Add secondary link or ensure route is discoverable.
